sourceEvidence.title: Plant Manager - Bourbon
sourceEvidence.quote:
Imperial is seeking a dynamic and experienced Plant Manager to lead all operations at our Bourbon, MO facility. This role is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the facility, including full Profit & Loss (P&L) responsibility. The Plant Manager leads safety, quality, production, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and continuous improvement while ensuring the plant meets customer expectations and business objectives.

The Bourbon facility is a larger and increasingly complex manufacturing operation currently supporting both hat embroidery and apparel screen printing. With planned growth in the facility, the Plant Manager will be responsible for building the people, processes, capacity, equipment, and organizational capability needed to support that growth while maintaining strong performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer service.
